broker.name: M4Markets
broker.tagline: On its own site since 2019. Its site names FSA (Seychelles), CySEC, and DFSA. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:5000.
broker.about: M4Markets says it has operated since 2019. An address it publishes is Providence, Mahe, Seychelles (registered address, not labelled as a headquarters on the about page). Account names on its site include Standard, Raw Spread, Premium, Dynamic Leverage, Cent Account / USD and USDC, and Islamic Account. Platforms named there include MT4 and MT5. The site names these regulators: FSA (Seychelles), CySEC, and DFSA. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:5000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.headquarters: Providence, Mahe, Seychelles (registered address, not labelled as a headquarters on the about page)
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FSA (Seychelles): Trinota Markets (Global) Limited, SD035. CySEC: Harindale Ltd, 301/16. DFSA: Oryx Finance Limited, F007051.

plans.name: Standard
plans.billing_note: Spreads from 1.1 pips. Max leverage 1:1000. Minimum volume from 0.01. Margin call 100%. Stop out 20%. Commission $0 on indices, energies, cryptos, forex and metals. Currencies USD, EUR, ZAR, JPY. Swap-free available.

plans.name: Raw Spread
plans.billing_note: Raw spreads from 0.0 pips. Max leverage 1:500. Stop out 40%. Forex and metals commission $7. Indices, energies and cryptos $0.

plans.name: Premium
plans.billing_note: Raw spreads from 0.0 pips. Max leverage 1:500. Stop out 40%. Forex and metals commission $5. Indices, energies and cryptos $0.

plans.name: Dynamic Leverage
plans.billing_note: Spreads from 1.6 pips. Max leverage 1:5000. Stop out 30%. Account currency USD. Commission $0. Page says 1:5000 on FX majors and that leverage adjusts with volume.

plans.name: Cent Account / USD and USDC
plans.billing_note: Spreads from 1.6 pips. Max leverage 1:1000. Stop out 20%. Commission $0. Footnote: FX contract size is 1000 units per 1 lot, so 0.01 lots is 10 units, Cent only.

plans.name: Islamic Account
plans.billing_note: Swap-free option for clients who do not want swap or interest. No separate price shown.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: Trading accounts page: Standard, Dynamic Leverage and Cent list $5. Raw Spread lists $500. Premium lists $10.000 as printed on the page (not rewritten). A footnote says $5 deposits are eligible only with selected payment providers. Because the amount depends on account type, no single minimum is recorded.

other_fees.label: Fund insurance
other_fees.note: About page says clients benefit from a fund insurance policy of up to USD 1,000,000, underwritten through Lloyd's.
